nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the shared WebXR library that re-exports all public types and functions from the device, error, events, frame, hand, hittest, input, layer, mock, registry, session, space, util, and view submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust library crate root that provides cohesive public API surface through re-exports.

nodes.name: mock.rs
nodes.summary: WebXR testing and simulation framework defining mock device APIs, message protocols for simulating device behavior, input source dynamics, and virtual 3D worlds for hit testing.

nodes.name: MockDiscoveryAPI
nodes.summary: Mock DiscoveryAPI trait that simulates device connections for testing purposes without real hardware.

nodes.name: MockDeviceInit
nodes.summary: Initialization parameters for mock devices including floor/viewer origins, VR/AR/inline support flags, views, supported features, and hit test world geometry.

nodes.name: MockViewInit
nodes.summary: Mock view initialization data with transform, projection matrix, viewport, and field of view settings.

nodes.name: MockViewsInit
nodes.summary: Enum for mock view initialization supporting Mono and Stereo view configurations.

nodes.name: MockDeviceMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for controlling mock device state including viewer/floor origin, views, input sources, visibility, world geometry, and pose resets.

nodes.name: MockInputInit
nodes.summary: Mock input source initialization parameters including source description, pointer/grip origins, and supported buttons.

nodes.name: MockInputMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for controlling mock input device state including handedness, ray mode, profiles, origins, select triggers, connect/disconnect, and button state updates.

nodes.name: MockRegion
nodes.summary: A region in the mock hit test world consisting of triangle faces and an entity type classification.

nodes.name: MockWorld
nodes.summary: The virtual 3D world for mock hit testing, containing a vector of MockRegion objects.

nodes.name: MockButtonType
nodes.summary: Enum for mock controller button types: Grip, Touchpad, Thumbstick, OptionalButton, and OptionalThumbstick.

nodes.name: MockButton
nodes.summary: Represents the state of a mock controller button including type, press/touch state, pressed value, and 2D axis values.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: WebXR device registry that manages discovery, session creation, and mock device simulation through a thread-safe message-passing architecture between the main thread and XR sessions.

nodes.name: Registry
nodes.summary: Thread-safe handle for a MainThreadRegistry that sends session requests and supports queries through a channel-based message passing protocol.

nodes.name: MainThreadRegistry
nodes.summary: Central WebXR registry running on the main thread that manages device discoveries, active sessions, mock devices, and message dispatch for session lifecycle operations.

nodes.name: MainThreadWakerImpl
nodes.summary: Callback-based waker implementation that signals the main thread when new messages are available in the registry channel.

nodes.name: RegistryMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for the registry's internal channel protocol with variants for session requests, support queries, and mock device connection simulation.

nodes.name: supports_session
nodes.summary: Queries the registry whether a given session mode is supported by any registered discovery, communicating via channel message.

nodes.name: request_session
nodes.summary: Requests a new XR session with the specified mode and init parameters, communicating through the registry channel.

nodes.name: simulate_device_connection
nodes.summary: Simulates a device connection in the mock system by sending a SimulateDeviceConnection message through the registry channel.

nodes.name: MainThreadRegistry::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new MainThreadRegistry with channel setup, waker initialization, and empty collections for discoveries, sessions, and mock devices.

nodes.name: handle_msg
nodes.summary: Dispatches incoming registry messages to the appropriate handler: supports_session, request_session, or simulate_device_connection.

nodes.name: MainThreadRegistry::request_session
nodes.summary: Creates a new XR session by querying discoveries, building a SessionThread with a layer grand manager, and returning the session handle.

nodes.name: MainThreadRegistry::simulate_device_connection
nodes.summary: Simulates a device connection by finding a mock discovery, calling its simulate_device_connection method, and inserting the resulting discovery into the registry.

nodes.name: run_on_main_thread
nodes.summary: Registers a session thread to run on the main thread by adding it to the sessions collection.

nodes.name: run_one_frame
nodes.summary: Processes one frame for all active sessions by draining registry messages and advancing each session one frame.

nodes.name: session.rs
nodes.summary: Core WebXR session implementation with session mode and feature validation, message-driven SessionThread for per-session rendering loops, and SessionBuilder for spawning sessions on dedicated threads or the main thread.

nodes.name: SessionMode
nodes.summary: Enum for XR session modes: Inline, ImmersiveVR, and ImmersiveAR.

nodes.name: SessionInit
nodes.summary: Session initialization parameters containing required and optional feature requests and first-person observer view flag, with validation logic.

nodes.name: EnvironmentBlendMode
nodes.summary: Enum for XR environment blend modes: Opaque, AlphaBlend, and Additive.

nodes.name: SessionMsg
nodes.summary: Message enum for the session's internal channel protocol supporting layer management, rendering control, hit testing, frame rate control, and session lifecycle operations.

nodes.name: Quitter
nodes.summary: Session quitter handle that sends a Quit message through its channel to terminate the session.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Client-side session handle providing methods for layer management, rendering, hit testing, frame rate control, and session state queries through message passing.

nodes.name: RenderState
nodes.summary: Enum for the session render loop state machine: NotInRenderLoop, InRenderLoop, and PendingQuit.

nodes.name: SessionThread
nodes.summary: Internal session thread that manages a message receiver, device handle, layer tracking, frame counting, and render state for the per-session rendering loop.

nodes.name: MainThreadSession
nodes.summary: Wrapper for running a session on the main thread, providing run_one_frame and running query methods.

nodes.name: SessionBuilder
nodes.summary: Builder for creating XR sessions with support for spawning on dedicated threads or running on the main thread, parameterized by graphics layer factory.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates session init against supported features, checking required features and collecting granted optional features.

nodes.name: Session::create_layer
nodes.summary: Creates an XR layer by sending a CreateLayer message to the session thread and waiting for the result.

nodes.name: Session::recommended_framebuffer_resolution
nodes.summary: Computes the recommended framebuffer resolution by unioning all viewport rectangles from the session views.

nodes.name: SessionThread::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new SessionThread with channel setup, device quitter registration, and initializes layer tracking.

nodes.name: new_session
nodes.summary: Initializes a new session state by querying device capabilities and returning the initial session metadata.

nodes.name: handle_msg
nodes.summary: Main message dispatcher for SessionThread handling all session operations including layer management, rendering control, hit testing, frame rate control, and quit.

nodes.name: SessionBuilder::new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new SessionBuilder with session collection, frame sender, layer grand manager, and session ID.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns an XR session on a dedicated thread, creating the graphics factory, session thread, and returning the session handle through a channel-based handshake.

nodes.name: run_on_main_thread
nodes.summary: Creates a session to run on the main thread by building the graphics factory, session thread, and wrapping it in a MainThreadSession.

nodes.name: space.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebXR reference space types including ApiSpace for cross-platform spatial indexing, BaseSpace enum for standard reference space types, and Space struct combining a base space with an offset transform.

nodes.name: BaseSpace
nodes.summary: Enum for WebXR reference space types: Local, Floor, Viewer, BoundedFloor, TargetRay, Grip, and Joint.

nodes.name: Space
nodes.summary: Combines a BaseSpace reference space type with an offset RigidTransform3D for relative positioning.

nodes.name: util.rs
nodes.summary: WebXR utility module providing clip plane management with update tracking, hit test list queuing with deferred commit, and projection matrix construction from field of view or frustum parameters.

nodes.name: ClipPlanes
nodes.summary: Tracks near and far clip plane values with a flag to detect recent updates for synchronization with the XR device.

nodes.name: HitTestList
nodes.summary: Manages a queue of pending and committed hit test sources, providing methods for requesting, committing, querying, and canceling hit tests.

nodes.name: fov_to_projection_matrix
nodes.summary: Computes a 3D projection matrix from field of view angles (left, right, top, bottom) and clip planes.

nodes.name: frustum_to_projection_matrix
nodes.summary: Computes a perspective projection matrix from frustum parameters (left, right, top, bottom) and near/far clip planes.

nodes.name: view.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WebXR view types including marker types for eye and cubemap faces, View struct with transform and projection, Views enum for view configurations, and Viewports for multi-view rendering.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: An XR view with a rigid transform and projection matrix, supporting default construction and unit casting.

nodes.name: Views
nodes.summary: Enum for XR view configurations: Inline, Mono, Stereo, StereoCapture, and Cubemap.

nodes.name: Viewports
nodes.summary: Container for a vector of viewport rectangles used in multi-view rendering.

nodes.name: cast_unit
nodes.summary: Casts the View's transform and projection between different unit types for coordinate system conversions.
